fml.menu.mods.info.description.residual:
Rediscover the lost art of building intelligence from scratch.

Someone lived in this world before you, and they seem to have built machines that thought. Find what is left of them, put a model drive in a Model Core, step inside the model it holds, and train it on real text with real gradients.
